optimizedContext.value:
# Get Spec Context

## Rules
- Resolve via `ListWorkspaces.execute()`: matching workspace or `WorkspaceNotFoundError`; `repo.get(specPath)` or `SpecNotFoundError`.
- Per spec: load artifacts; usable metadata via `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` default `if-needed`; never `SpecRepository.metadata()` directly.
- Modes: `list` = spec/stale/mode/source; `summary` + title/description; `full` + rules/constraints/scenarios; `hybrid` ≡ `full` for single-spec command.
- Materialization success → render from metadata, `stale: false`. Cache-miss regeneration is provenance (`source`, `regenerated`) — MUST NOT warn solely for regeneration. Only actionable failures e.g. `metadata-cache-write-failed` go to `warnings`.
- If `llmOptimizedContext: true`, prefer `optimizedContext` when present+fresh. Missing/stale/empty → fall back to standard `context` + warning: "Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh". Types: `missing-optimization` (never optimized) vs `stale-optimization` (baselines drifted). Freshness from lock-owned per-field baselines (`core:spec-optimization`), not metadata-doc freshness.
- Unusable projection: list = spec+`stale: true`+mode/source; summary/full/hybrid = + any safe title/description. No rules/constraints/scenarios. Materialization failure, not raw hash staleness.
- Non-empty `input.sections`: full-mode only those of `rules|constraints|scenarios`. title/description in full only when no section filter. Filters never affect `list` or `summary`.
- `followDeps: true`: DFS + cycle detection. Canonical `dependsOn` from `GetSpecMetadata`; if no projection MAY use schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn`; else no outgoing deps. `depth` 0 = root only; omitted = unlimited.
- Traversal warns, continues: unusable projection = `missing-metadata`; unknown ws = `unknown-workspace`; absent spec = `missing-spec`; stale/missing lock-owned optimization when optimization enabled = `stale-optimization`. Never generic `spec-lock.json` reads; sidecars only via `GetSpecMetadata`.
- Result: `entries` root-first then DFS; `warnings` accumulated. Each entry: canonical spec label + display mode.
- Config factory via `resolveGetSpecContextDeps`: `listWorkspaces`, `hasher`, `getMetadata`, `schemaProvider?`, `parsers?`, `extractorTransforms`, `workspaceRoutes`. MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints
- Repository access only through orchestrated ListWorkspaces; never mutate returned workspaces/repos
- Cycle identity: `workspace:capabilityPath`
- Root always first/included, even stale
- Empty `sections` equals undefined: show all
